high_level_description: A sparse 1600x900 structural draft highlighting precise physical interactions: left-side human-hose-bicycle-fence linkage, right-side animal-object-ladybug-chain linkage, all on plain white background.

compositional_deconstruction.background: plain white canvas, no ground, sky, or texture

elements.desc: woman bending: dark blue torso (rectangle), light blue arm (line), navy head (circle), positioned left-center
hose nozzle: dark gray rectangle attached to woman's hand
curved water arc: smooth blue cubic Bézier path from nozzle to near fence
bicycle: two black wheels (circles) + gray frame (polygon), leaning rightward
short fence segment: three vertical brown rectangles + horizontal rail
oak trunk: thick vertical brown rectangle at right cluster base
terrier digging: brown oval body + small black circle head, near oak trunk base
pickup truck: gray rounded rectangle with distinct hood area
cat sitting on truck hood: orange circle
red tennis ball near oak trunk base
low oak branch: short brown diagonal line extending from trunk
ladybug chain: 6 red-and-black segmented ovals following curved path from branch tip to tennis ball
drone: small gray cross-shaped symbol above right cluster
